attBesluta.text: A quality product that I self installed, went up with ease. Used a grinder and a zip blade to cut, easier than sheetmetal snips as shown. Self tapping screws were good, pre-drilled holes while on the ground to make it easier on the ladder. Fit the 5 inch K style eavestrough very well. The leaves and pine needles are falling now and I am in much better shape, no future potential of plugged eavestrough.

I'm impressed with the quality of this product. The aluminum lower layer is thicker and sturdier than expected. Compared to the plastic screen support of the L**f F****r product that my neighbor had installed, this one is far superior and will maintain its strength indefinitely, unlike plastic. Although the instructions suggest tin snips for cutting the sections, I found it extremely difficult to cut this way, due to the thickness of the metal. I suggest using an angle grinder and a cutoff wheel. This produces much cleaner cuts and does not deform the metal like tin snips do. I will mention that I had to flatten out the angled part of the sections that goes up under the shingles, which added to the time needed to complete the project. This might or might not be necessary for your roof, but it made for a much easier and cleaner installation on my roof.
